problem.title: Count Elements in Range
problem.problemStatement: Given an integer array and multiple queries [L, R], return the number of elements lying within the specified index range. Preprocess the array using prefix sums.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums Integer q Queries (L, R)
problem.output: For each query, print the count of elements.
